=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/clarify_github_facts.py:61-192 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Branch references that already include `refs/heads/` are prefixed a second time in the GraphQL query, causing existing branches to be reported as nonexistent.
  WHY: The query uses `refs/heads/refs/heads/<branch>` for these inputs, and all six reviewers reported that this returns no branch target and supplies false GitHub facts.
- scripts/auto_decisions.py:76-210 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: ANSWER_RE and RATIONALE_RE do not accept leading Markdown list bullets, so bulleted answers or rationales can be omitted and decisions classified as undecided.
  WHY: Reviewers report that OPTION_RE accepts bullet prefixes while these regexes do not; severity is high, with deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro rating the issue NIT rather than MAJOR.
- .claude/commands/audit-plans.md:103-127 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The command file differs from its workflow template even though the parity test requires byte-identical files.
  WHY: The mismatch causes `test_audit_plans_command.py::test_template_parity` to fail in CI; both reviewers rate this BLOCKER.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:351-359 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `GIT_DIR+=...` handler records the partial appended value in the environment even though it marks the repository context uncertain.
  WHY: These reviewers say the partial value reaches git subprocesses and can make branch resolution inspect the wrong repository; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 disagree, stating the uncertain path discards the environment.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:353-402 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A `GIT_DIR+=...` push may use an alternate repository while the guard checks the session checkout, allowing a push from an alternate repository when the session checkout is on its default branch.
  WHY: openai_gpt-6-luna reports that the uncertain-context fallback can skip the PR-status check; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 dispute this concern and say the fallback is conservative.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/clarify_github_facts.py:lines 61 and 146 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The INTEGRATION_RE captures branch names that may contain a `refs/heads/` prefix written verbatim in issue text, resulting in a duplicated prefix in the GraphQL query.
  WHY: A prefixed branch token becomes `refs/heads/refs/heads/some-branch`, causing `collect` to falsely report that the branch does not exist.
- scripts/auto_decisions.py:lines 81-82, ANSWER_RE, and line 203 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: ANSWER_RE does not accept a leading bullet marker such as `- ` or `* `.
  WHY: If output uses a bulleted answer such as `- Q1: C`, ANSWER_RE produces no match and the auto-decision record is omitted.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  PROBLEM: `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` diverged from its workflow template.
  WHY: `test_audit_plans_command.py:30` asserts byte-identical equality, so the test fails in CI.
- scripts/auto_decisions.py:lines 82-84 (ANSWER_RE and RATIONALE_RE) and lines 203-210 (_answer_sections) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: ANSWER_RE and RATIONALE_RE do not accommodate optional leading Markdown list bullet prefixes.
  WHY: Bulleted answer or rationale lines fail to match, causing question identifiers to be omitted from picks and classified as undecided.
- scripts/clarify_github_facts.py:line 146 in build_query() | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: build_query() unconditionally prefixes branch tokens with `refs/heads/`.
  WHY: A branch reference already containing that prefix gets queried as `refs/heads/refs/heads/branch-name` and reported as nonexistent.
- scripts/auto_decisions.py:lines 214-216 in _answer_sections() | PROBLEM: Multi-line setup bullet points under SETUP REQUIRED: drop wrapped continuation lines.
  WHY: Only lines matching BULLET_RE are captured, so setup details can be omitted.

  PROBLEM: ANSWER_RE and RATIONALE_RE do not accept an optional leading list bullet, unlike OPTION_RE.
  WHY: Bulleted answer and rationale lines fail to match, so from_answers classifies the Q-IDs as undecided and emits no decisions or AD entries.

  PROBLEM: INTEGRATION_RE can capture a `refs/heads/` prefix, which build_query prepends again.
  WHY: The malformed GraphQL qualifiedName resolves to null, so collect reports a branch as nonexistent.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 351-359 (the `+=` branch in _guarded_git_invocations) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The `+=` branch marks the repository context uncertain but still stores the partial appended value in the environment.
  WHY: The partial GIT_DIR can affect later git subprocesses and branch resolution.

- scripts/clarify_github_facts.py:117-122, 146, 189-192 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Branch references that already include the `refs/heads/` prefix are prefixed a second time when constructing the GraphQL query.
  WHY: The null query result is reported as “does not exist,” giving the clarify-respond worker incorrect GitHub facts.
- scripts/auto_decisions.py:213-216 in _answer_sections() | PROBLEM: Non-bullet continuation lines in a multi-line `SETUP REQUIRED` item are discarded.

- scripts/auto_decisions.py:lines 82-84 (ANSWER_RE and RATIONALE_RE) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The regexes accept optional bold markers but do not accept leading Markdown list bullets.
  WHY: Bulleted DECISIONS or RATIONALE lines fail to match, so the Q-IDs remain unextracted and auto-decision records are omitted.
- scripts/clarify_github_facts.py:line 175 in build_query (the `refs/heads/{branch}` interpolation) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A referenced branch already including `refs/heads/` receives another prefix in build_query.
  WHY: The GraphQL ref query returns null, causing collect() to falsely report that the branch does not exist.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:lines 351-359 in _guarded_git_invocations (the `+=` append handler) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: For `GIT_DIR+=/foo`, the code also stores the partial appended value in environment["GIT_DIR"].
  WHY: The partial value can point git subprocesses at the wrong repository and make the guard check the wrong branch.
